entries.title: Your first mate notices a crewmate that stopped while an old notice still waited for it
entries.body: A crewmate that reported and stopped could look busy to your first mate for hours when only a notice it had already heard, such as a change to the task's rigor, or a message left long undelivered, still waited for it. Your first mate is now told when such a crewmate reports, and reminded if it stays idle.
entries.noPicture: This changes when your first mate hears about idle work, not how any view looks.
